newsitem.title: EGYPT: Life in jail for Egypt teacher who abused girls.
newsitem.headline: Life in jail for Egypt teacher who abused girls.

text.p: A Cairo criminal court on Sunday sentenced a primary school teacher to life imprisonment with hard labour for sexually assaulting 16 schoolgirls, security sources said.
Issam Ahmed Bekheet, 36, had confessed to various crimes include touching the girls' genitals and ordering them to perform sexual favours, the sources said.

The court said it gave Bekheet the maximum penalty for such crimes under Egyptian law because as a teacher he had power over the girls, whose ages range from nine to 12. He is married with four children.
Police arrested Bekheet after one of the girls told her father.
